minutes.headline: Charter committee favored a permanent fall town meeting and time-limited Saturday sessions; no votes taken
minutes.summary: The committee heard board responses and a letter from the Town Moderator proposing charter changes. It discussed a permanent second town meeting, Saturday meeting hours, representative town meeting (not favored), elected versus appointed positions and a facilities director. It agreed to take up Articles 1 and 2 at the next meeting and to ask boards for initial feedback by December.

what_happened.line: The Charter Review Committee took no votes; it favored a permanent second, fall town meeting and time-limited Saturday sessions, and did not favor a representative town meeting.
The committee agreed to go through the Charter section by section, starting with Articles 1 and 2 at its next meeting.
The committee agreed to ask town boards for initial feedback by December.
A member will build a spreadsheet of elected and appointed positions and who appoints them.
Minutes of the prior meeting were held until the next meeting because they were not distributed.

why_it_matters: A permanent fall town meeting would change when residents vote on spending, since it would fall before the tax rate is set, when state local aid is better known.

Whether positions such as town clerk are elected or appointed, and whether the town hires a facilities director, would change who residents vote for and how building repairs are paid for through the town budget, mostly taxes.
